observations: Each mode change (walk, drop, hang, floor, pool) is marked by a crate cluster.
Crate piles signpost drop holes at apparent dead ends (S1-b, S4-a).
Hanging crates teach then test the hanging spin, one per patrol window.
Long hanging runs carry only 5 crates: timing is the challenge there.
The single mask sits right before the bobbing mines and the TNT wall.
TNT wall (support order) and Nitro wall (switch) are the same wall read two ways.
The green switch is shown before the wall it clears; a Nitro row earlier creates the need.
The bonus holds ~40% of the boxes and all the dense crate puzzles.
The secret exit has no boxes: box gem and secret never compete.
